import pathlib,json,subprocess,shutil,datetime
R=pathlib.Path('E:/PCControlAutonomyR41')
SHA='506f9a951f9b782e27b0d886e441b6747095e3fc'
SOURCE=R/'releases'/SHA
CFG=R/'config.r41-integrated.json'
TASK='PCControl-R41-Observer'
if not SOURCE.is_dir() or not CFG.is_file():raise RuntimeError('R41_INSTALL_MISSING')
c=json.loads(CFG.read_text('utf8'))
plan=json.loads(pathlib.Path(c['r45']['plan']).read_text('utf8'))
if c.get('mode')!='observe' or c.get('operatorApproved') is not False or plan.get('allowDispatch') is not False:raise RuntimeError('R41_CONFIG_NOT_READ_ONLY')
if (R/'START_R41_OBSERVER.cmd').exists() or (R/'STOP_R41_OBSERVER.cmd').exists():raise RuntimeError('R41_LAUNCHER_ALREADY_PRESENT')
check=subprocess.run(['schtasks.exe','/Query','/TN',TASK],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
if check.returncode==0:raise RuntimeError('R41_SCHEDULED_TASK_ALREADY_EXISTS')
node=shutil.which('node')
if not node:raise RuntimeError('NODE_NOT_INSTALLED')
(R/'logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
lines=['@echo off','setlocal','cd /d "'+str(SOURCE)+'"','"'+node+'" "'+str(SOURCE/'bin/pc-autonomy-daemon.js')+'" --config "'+str(CFG)+'" --watch >> "'+str(R/'logs/observer.stdout.log')+'" 2>&1','exit /b %errorlevel%']
start=R/'START_R41_OBSERVER.cmd';stop=R/'STOP_R41_OBSERVER.cmd'
with start.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:f.write('\r\n'.join(lines)+'\r\n')
with stop.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:f.write('@echo off\r\nschtasks.exe /End /TN "'+TASK+'"\r\nschtasks.exe /Delete /TN "'+TASK+'" /F\r\n')
cmd='cmd.exe /d /c "'+str(start)+'"'
created=subprocess.run(['schtasks.exe','/Create','/SC','ONLOGON','/TN',TASK,'/TR',cmd,'/RL','LIMITED'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
meta={'status':'REGISTERED' if created.returncode==0 else 'FAILED','task':TASK,'readOnly':True,'source':SHA,'createdAt':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),'sendEnabled':False,'noExistingTasksModified':True}
(R/'AUTOSTART_R41.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps({'registered':created.returncode==0,'task':TASK,'returncode':created.returncode,'nodePresent':True,'startScript':str(start),'rollbackScript':str(stop),'message':(created.stdout+created.stderr)[-380:],'newProviderMessages':0,'productionModified':False,'notStartedYet':True},ensure_ascii=True))

note: User-authorized dedicated Windows ONLOGON observer-only PC Control R41 task. No --dispatch, no browser/queue/mcp production edits; preserve other tasks; reversible with exact STOP_R41_OBSERVER.cmd. Never reexecute unknown result.
